0022600187.text: The Suns, who are 1-5 and on a four-game losing streak, host the Orlando Magic in their seventh game of the season. Phoenix sits 3rd in the Pacific, 4.5 games back and 12th in the West, with a 1-2 home record. Orlando is 2-5 after two straight losses, sits 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back and 12th in the East, and is 0-4 at home but 2-1 on the road; the teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Suns' most recent meeting a 115-111 loss in Orlando on March 31, 2026, and no games yet this season. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain).
